verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list integer quantization formats including INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF and compressed-tensors, and state that quantization trades precision for a smaller memory footprint. A community post also credits its low-precision model library. One early HN comment said 4-bit wasn't supported, but it comes from the launch-era thread and doesn't concretely contradict the current documented INT4/GPTQ/AWQ support. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sub-4-bit (2–3 bit) integer support, which GGUF/GPTQ only imply, and recent independent hands-on corroboration of the integer formats' memory savings.
